name: ai_governance_policy_resources
description: This repository collects resources on AI governance, policy, regulation, institutions, incidents, accountability, labor, civil society critique, and the social consequences of AI deployment.

name: ai_assessment_implementation_resources
description: This repository collects practical resources for assessing, testing, documenting, and implementing responsible machine learning systems, including frameworks, evaluation tools, educational materials, and community guidance.

name: ai_research_guides
description: HallResearch.ai AI Research Guides offers curated, topic-focused pathways through the HallResearch.ai Library. Each guide brings together selected sources, questions, and orientation material to help users explore AI governance, policy, assessment, and implementation topics.
